The Big Story · Population & the Future

Japan is one decimal point from a number that changes everything.

It sounds like a statistic. Follow it through a convenience store, a hospital, a train station and a small town, however, and it becomes the story of how an entire country is redesigning everyday life.

By Yuji Shimizu · YUJI @ Japan
Updated 08:30 JST · 9 min read
The number behind today29.6%Nearly three in ten people in Japan are now 65 or older.

The real surprise is not that Japan is aging. It is where the change becomes visible next.
